title: 10/18 checkpoint: redesign CUSTOMER ACQUISITION (WHO/PAIN/OFFER/TRUST/REACH before channel), ≥3 hypotheses, pick one and hit the market in the same fire
detail: OWNER RULE 2026-10-17 (ops/2026-10/CHECKPOINT_1018.md §0 is the central question: how do we actually win a customer?). Do NOT start from a channel — CrowdWorks/X/Coconala are execution means. First answer WHO (industry/role/size/task/situation), PAIN, TRIGGER, OFFER (what/price/scope), WHY NOW, TRUST (demo/sample/Before-After/free diagnosis/deliverable up front), WHERE (where that customer actually gathers), HOW TO REACH (compare posted-job replies, search inflow, communities, referral, direct proposal, partners, existing network), FIRST CONVERSION (low-risk first offer), REPEATABILITY. Build ≥3 genuinely different acquisition hypotheses, each with customer, pain, offer, reach, trust, steps to first close, first market test, 48h signal — then the channel. Pick ONE and put it in front of real customers INSIDE this fire (live URL / post id / sent proposal / published listing; cloud-executable preferred; P1 mac-local task only for the browser part). Then: replies 0 → L4+ redesign, 'continue because proposals are few' FORBIDDEN; 6-dimension comparison; stop replaced tasks, create new tasks, reallocate, redesign event, STATE update. Start from status/2026-10/decisions/CHECKPOINT_1018_PREP.md (draft only — re-derive from the customer, not from the draft's channel list). decision_check enforces checkpoint_1018 (acquisition_hypotheses, chosen_hypothesis, executed.market_test) on the earliest 10/18 report.
acceptance: earliest 2026-10-18 decision report passes decision_check with checkpoint_1018; stopped/new tasks exist; redesign event logged
